verdict.rationale: Requesty's quickstart says existing OpenAI SDK users only need to point the SDK at Requesty, with no SDK changes. It shows the base_url swap from api.openai.com/v1 to router.requesty.ai/v1, and llms.txt describes the product as an OpenAI-compatible API. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that unmodified OpenAI code works end-to-end with only the base URL and key changed.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible code at the gateway by changing only the base URL and key

citations.quote: If you're already using the OpenAI SDK, point it at Requesty and you're done. No SDK changes, no new client to learn.
Requesty is a unified LLM gateway and OpenAI-compatible API for 300+ AI models
